shouldFix.title: The new class-predicate rule quantifies over every scope conditional but one nullWhen still belongs to the consent-carrier domain
evidence: classPredicateDomain.rule says: 'Every when / nullWhen / requiredWhen predicate in this scope shape uses only these four literals,' where closedValues is exactly CA-1, CA-2, CA-3, CA-4.

A complete recursive enumeration finds nine such conditionals. Eight use only CA-1..CA-4, but policyProvenance.nullWhen is exactly 'invocation-time-naming', which is absent from the declared classPredicateDomain.

doctorV4FieldMapping confirms that invocation-time-naming is a consentCarrier value: consentCarrier is disclosed in residualLimitation, while policyProvenance enters scope only for pre-existing-policy. This is a second discriminator domain, not a serialized actionClass spelling.

FC-BOUND-SHAPE's new parentRecords cover the four actionClass rows only. They do not exercise invocation-time-naming versus pre-existing-policy and therefore cannot prove the universal every-conditional assertion.

The intended HAE7-CX-01 repair otherwise lands: no scope when/nullWhen/requiredWhen contains CA-1-HOST-HEAD or CA-4-HOST, and the CA-1/CA-2/CA-3/CA-4 byteCap, targetIdentity, and endpointSet branches are explicit.
shouldFix.impact: The action-class discriminator repair itself is present, but the governing totality sentence is false on the closed scope schema. An implementation must either apply the action-class domain to a consent-carrier predicate and reject a lawful invocation-time record, ignore the governing sentence, or invent an unstated exception. The candidate therefore does not yet provide one unambiguous total predicate-domain contract.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Narrow classPredicateDomain.rule to every conditional whose discriminator is consentRecords[].actionClass, while continuing to forbid CA-1-HOST-HEAD and CA-4-HOST in those predicates. Separately declare policyProvenance.nullWhen as a consentCarrier-domain predicate with the closed carrier values invocation-time-naming and pre-existing-policy and a named source/join. Extend a fixture class to cover both carrier branches, or otherwise make the exception machine-checkable.
